rationale: It describes a graphical PostgreSQL development client for writing SQL, developing databases, connecting to servers, and working with database objects—conventional database tooling.
evidence_spans: an easy-to-use graphical tool for PostgreSQL database development. From writing simple SQL queries to developing complex databases
Connect to local/remote PostgreSQL servers and compatible with cloud databases like Amazon Redshift, Amazon Aurora, Amazon RDS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure, and all PostgreSQL database objects.
